name: בינום של ניוטון – פיתוח (a + bx)⁵ (באנגלית)
generalfeedback:
Outline: Use the binomial theorem with \(n=5\): compute each binomial coefficient, multiply it by the powers of the two terms, and add.
Step 1 — The binomial theorem
For \(n\) a positive integer then by the binomial theorem

\[ \left(a + b\right)^n = a^n + \frac{n!}{\left(n-1\right)!\cdot 1!}a^{n-1}\cdot b + \ldots+\frac{n!}{\left(n-r\right)!\cdot r!}a^{n-r}\cdot b^r + \ldots + b^n\mbox{.} \]

In this case \(a={{CT:1}}\), \(b={{CT:2}}\) and \(n=5\); therefore

\[ \begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle \left({{CT:0}}\right)^5 = \left({{CT:1}}\right)^5 + 5\cdot \left({{CT:1}}\right)^4 \cdot \left({{CT:2}}\right) \cdot x + \frac{5\cdot 4}{2!} \cdot \left({{CT:1}}\right)^3 \cdot \left({{CT:2}}\right)^2 \cdot x^2 + \frac{5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3}{3!} \cdot \left({{CT:1}}\right)^2 \cdot \left({{CT:2}}\right)^3 \cdot x^3\mbox{,} \\ + \frac{5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2}{4!} \cdot \left({{CT:1}}\right) \cdot \left({{CT:2}}\right)^4 \cdot x^4 + \left({{CT:2}}\right)^5 \cdot x^5\mbox{,} \end{array} \]

where

\[ \begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle 2!&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle 2 \cdot 1 = 2\mbox{,}\\ 3!&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1 = 3 \cdot 2! = 6\mbox{,}\\ 4!&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1 = 4 \cdot 3! = 24\mbox{.} \end{array} \]

Step 2 — Each term
The general term is \(\binom{5}{k}a^{5-k}b^k x^k\):

\[ k=0:\quad {{CT:3}}\cdot\left({{CT:1}}\right)^{5}\cdot\left({{CT:2}}\right)^{0}={{CT:4}} \]

\[ k=1:\quad {{CT:5}}\cdot\left({{CT:1}}\right)^{4}\cdot\left({{CT:2}}\right)^{1}={{CT:6}}x \]

\[ k=2:\quad {{CT:7}}\cdot\left({{CT:1}}\right)^{3}\cdot\left({{CT:2}}\right)^{2}={{CT:8}}x^2 \]

\[ k=3:\quad {{CT:9}}\cdot\left({{CT:1}}\right)^{2}\cdot\left({{CT:2}}\right)^{3}={{CT:10}}x^3 \]

\[ k=4:\quad {{CT:11}}\cdot\left({{CT:1}}\right)^{1}\cdot\left({{CT:2}}\right)^{4}={{CT:12}}x^4 \]

\[ k=5:\quad {{CT:13}}\cdot\left({{CT:1}}\right)^{0}\cdot\left({{CT:2}}\right)^{5}={{CT:14}}x^5 \]

Step 3 — The result
So

\[ \left({{CT:0}}\right)^5 = {{CT:15}}\mbox{.} \]
